model_syntax:
# =======================================
  # Reflective Measurement Model
  # =======================================
  Attitude =~ att_appealing + att_desirable +
              att_goodidea + att_pleasant
  PBC =~ pbc_barrier + pbc_could +
         pbc_resources
  DescriptiveNorms =~ norms_d_many + norms_d_common +
                      norms_d_few
  InjunctiveNorms =~ norms_i_consider + norms_i_bad +
                     norms_i_support



  # Reflective utility constructs
  # Adding performance perceptions to the model B3x.1A 
  
  PowerPerc =~ bev_better_towing +
             bev_better_roughroad +
             bev_better_accel +
             bev_better_power
  
  NonPowerPerc =~ bev_better_comfort +
               bev_better_safety +
               bev_better_reliability
           
  RngCompat =~ fit_hh_prosp_fit +
                    fit_hh_prosp_plan +
                    fit_hh_prosp_shortnotice +
                    fit_hh_prosp_emergency + range_prosp_routine +
                     range_prosp_longtrip +
                     range_prosp_cold +
                     range_prosp_hills

  EVSE_perc =~ find_evse_prosp_nearby +
               find_evse_prosp_longtrip +
               find_evse_prosp_schedule

  Observability =~ observ_evs +
                   observ_charging +
                   observ_stations

  Intention =~ nextv_bev + nextv_phev + nextv_icev


  # =======================================
  # Structural path
  # ======================================= 
  # On Model B3y.1c2, adding cost and trialability composite 
  # 
  Intention ~ Attitude + PBC + InjunctiveNorms + DescriptiveNorms 
  Attitude ~  PowerPerc + NonPowerPerc + RngCompat + Observability + EVSE_perc  + trial_comp + cost_comp
  PBC ~ PowerPerc + NonPowerPerc + RngCompat + EVSE_perc  + trial_comp + cost_comp
  
  # Compared to model B3x.1A, compatibility now points towards both the norms. 
  DescriptiveNorms ~ Observability + RngCompat
  InjunctiveNorms ~ RngCompat
  
  # Endo-exo covariances of TPB core variables
  Attitude ~~ PBC
  Attitude ~~ InjunctiveNorms
  Attitude ~~ DescriptiveNorms
  
  PBC ~~ InjunctiveNorms
  PBC ~~ DescriptiveNorms
  
  InjunctiveNorms ~~ DescriptiveNorms
  
  # Additional exo covars for coposites
  trial_comp ~~ RngCompat + Observability + EVSE_perc + PowerPerc + NonPowerPerc + cost_comp
  cost_comp ~~ RngCompat + Observability + EVSE_perc + PowerPerc + NonPowerPerc
  
  # In addition, all exo ~~ exo allowed with auto.cov.lv.x = TRUE
